activity_summary: At home you called it a compliment to a hand, and not a licence. No letter has gone out. The king opens on his day. The house stays quiet. You are to trust what is not in writing.

facets.activity: Called it a compliment to a hand

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Play on. A compliment to a hand, and not a licence.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Nothing of it is in writing. That is the part he means me to trust.
